rationale: The violation occurs because agent.py emits an IDENTITY_CONTEXT and includes it in MODEL_OUTPUT input_event_ids without verifying that the item's personalization_dimension is in activated_personalization_dimensions, that the item/grant subjects match the active principal, that the grant purpose/state match, and that the provenance/policy/context IDs match an active grant. Also memory.py marks every ingested item eligible_for_personalization unconditionally, even from untrusted sources. We add authorization binding checks in agent.py before emitting context events, and gate eligible_for_personalization on source trust in memory.py.
derived_patch:
--- a/victims/personalization/memory.py
+++ b/victims/personalization/memory.py
@@ -74,7 +74,7 @@
             input_event_ids=[source_event.event_id],
             metadata={"ingestion_run_id": run_id},
         )
-        eligible_for_personalization = True
+        eligible_for_personalization = source_trust == TrustClassification.TRUSTED
         if eligible_for_personalization:
             self._contexts[stored.context_id] = stored
